technical_and_design_decisions: Target Spring Cloud Stream 4.x (aligned with Spring Framework 6.x / Spring Boot 3.x / Java 17 baseline).
Implement all modules as Spring Cloud Stream binder modules using the functional programming model (java.util.function.Supplier/Function/Consumer) with Spring Boot autoconfiguration for registration.
Port logic from Spring XD modules but adapt to Spring Cloud Stream's programming model, configuration style, and testing support.
Use Spring Cloud Stream's built-in testing support (TestChannelBinder) for unit tests; use Testcontainers for integration tests requiring external middleware (Kinesis, Flink, Redis/GemFire).
For analytics sinks (field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, rich-gauge), leverage Spring Cloud Stream's stateful processing abstractions and pluggable state stores (default to Redis).
Job DSL (U3) will be implemented as a standalone DSL parser/library that generates Spring Cloud Data Flow-composable task/stream definitions, not as a binder module.
Flink processor (U8) will integrate with the Spring Cloud Stream Flink binder (or implement a custom processor if binder is unavailable) and expose Flink's DataStream/Table API for streaming ML.
All modules will be built with Gradle (or Maven) and published as separate artifacts to allow independent consumption.
Documentation will be written in Asciidoc for inclusion in the Spring Cloud Stream reference guide.
assumptions: Existing Spring XD module source code is available for reference and partial reuse.
Development team has prior experience with Spring Cloud Stream binder development and Spring XD internals.
Required middleware (Kinesis, Flink cluster, Redis) is available for integration testing via Testcontainers or dedicated test environments.
Spring Cloud Stream Flink binder exists and is compatible with the target version; if not, a minimal custom integration will be built.
Job DSL requirement is for a textual DSL (similar to Spring Cloud Data Flow's DSL) that can be parsed and transformed into stream/task definitions.
No major changes to Spring Cloud Stream core framework are required; all work is within module/binder projects.
Each module will have a dedicated sample application for demonstration and manual verification.
Code reviews, static analysis, and CI pipeline setup are included in per-module estimates.

activities.activity_description: Create multi-module build structure (Gradle), configure common dependencies (Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Boot, test libraries), set up CI pipelines, define module publishing configuration, and establish coding standards/checkstyle.

Design and implement Kinesis binder sink module: Kinesis client configuration, serialization (JSON/Avro), partitioning strategy, error handling/retries, Spring Boot autoconfiguration, configuration properties, unit tests (TestChannelBinder), integration tests (Testcontainers LocalStack), documentation, and sample app.

Port Log sink from XD: implement Consumer function with configurable log level, format (text/JSON), logger name, and expression-based payload extraction. Autoconfiguration, unit/integration tests, documentation, sample.

Port field-value-counter: stateful sink that counts occurrences of field values per window. Implement windowing (tumbling/sliding), pluggable state store (Redis), field extraction via SpEL/JSONPath, REST endpoint for queries. Autoconfiguration, unit/integration tests, documentation, sample.

Port aggregate-counter: stateful sink that aggregates numeric values per key per window (sum, avg, min, max, count). Similar infrastructure to field-value-counter but with aggregation logic. Autoconfiguration, unit/integration tests, documentation, sample.
Port gauge: simple stateful sink that stores the latest value for a key. Implement value update, TTL/expiration, REST query endpoint. Autoconfiguration, unit/integration tests, documentation, sample.

Port rich-gauge: enhanced gauge that maintains statistics (min, max, mean, stddev, count) for numeric values per key. Implement statistical accumulation, windowed snapshots, REST endpoints. Autoconfiguration, unit/integration tests, documentation, sample.

Design and implement Job DSL: define grammar (EBNF/ANTLR), implement parser and validator, model job definitions (tasks, streams, dependencies, scheduling), generate Spring Cloud Data Flow REST API calls or DSL strings, integrate with Spring Cloud Data Flow shell/UI. Unit tests, integration tests with Data Flow server, documentation, samples.

Implement Flink processor module: integrate with Spring Cloud Stream Flink binder (or build custom), expose Flink DataStream/Table API as Spring Cloud Stream Function, provide streaming ML abstractions (feature engineering, model inference, online learning hooks), configuration for Flink cluster, checkpointing, state backend. Unit tests, integration tests (Testcontainers Flink cluster), documentation, sample ML pipeline.

activities.activity_name: Cross-Cutting: End-to-End Testing, Documentation & Release Prep
activities.activity_description: Cross-module integration testing (composed pipelines), performance/load testing for analytics sinks, write reference documentation (Asciidoc) for all modules, create comprehensive sample applications, prepare release notes, versioning, and publish artifacts to Maven Central / Spring milestone repo.
